name: android-tools
description: adb-based tools for Android development, written in Rust.

requirements.device: Connected Android device or emulator with USB debugging authorized

tools.name: adbkit
tools.description: Shared adb helpers for the android-tools workspace
tools.long_description: Library crate with device picking, shell/exec-out wrappers with timeouts, the uiautomator hierarchy model (XML to flat nodes, via roxmltree), and pure helpers. Tool-specific behaviour stays in the tools that own it.
features: Serial auto-pick when a single device is connected
shell_opt for commands whose failure is a normal outcome
shell_timeout with hard kill (uiautomator dump hangs)
exec_out for raw stdout (screencap)
resolve_launcher: a package's launcher activity, shared by uitool and startperf
uiautomator hierarchy parsing shared by the UI tools (roxmltree, testable without a device)

tools.name: logstream
tools.description: Live Android log streamer - logcat, but actually nice
tools.long_description: Streams `adb logcat` (threadtime, main/system/crash buffers) filtered to one app package, with a ratatui TUI (search, level/tag filters, pid tracking, crash and restart banners) plus plain and JSONL output modes for piping.
features: App-pid filtering with crash history kept across restarts
Auto package resolution (tries <pkg> then <pkg>.debug)
Crash / start / restart / died banners (AndroidRuntime FATAL EXCEPTION detection)
Stack-trace continuation lines merged into the record
Live TUI with regex search, level and tag filters
JSONL and plain modes for scripts, optional file mirror

tools.name: startperf
tools.description: App cold/warm start benchmark over adb
tools.long_description: Measures cold and warm app launch times without Android Studio: runs `am start -W` N times against an activity, parses the framework-reported timings (TotalTime/WaitTime/ThisTime), and summarizes them as min/median/mean/max/stddev. Reports as a table, JSON or CSV, and skips runs Android admits it did not really launch.
features: Cold mode force-stops before every run; warm mode presses HOME so the process stays alive and the activity is recreated
Runs where Android admits it launched nothing ("brought to the front" in cold mode, "top-most instance" anywhere) are skipped, not counted
min/median/mean/max/stddev — median reported because cold samples skew
JSON report and spreadsheet-ready CSV with one row per run
Launcher activity resolved automatically via adbkit (or pass --component)

tools.name: uitool
tools.description: Practical Android UI driver — dump, find, tap, shot over adb
tools.long_description: Drives a device UI from the command line: dumps the uiautomator hierarchy as labeled lines, finds/waits for nodes by text or content-desc, taps by label or coordinates, swipes, takes cropped/scaled screenshots, launches activities, sends keys and text.

requires.screen_on: uiautomator dump fails on a locked/off screen

features: Label-based interaction: tap/find/wait use text or content-desc, no coordinates needed
Clickable nodes preferred as tap target, bounds center computed automatically
uiautomator dump with hard timeout (no hangs) and screen-off detection
Screenshot pipeline: crop, nearest upscale, max-dim resize, JPEG quality
Serial auto-pick when exactly one device is connected (via adbkit)
